title: Specialist, Project Finance and M&A, LATAM
description:
About the Company:


Recurrent Energy is one of the world’s largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and operations platforms. With an industry-leading team of in-house energy experts, we are a wholly-owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and function as Canadian Solar’s global development and power services business.


About the Position:


The Project Finance and M&A Specialist will play a critical role in supporting the company’s growth across LATAM by performing advanced financial analysis, developing robust financial models, and assisting in the structuring and execution of complex transactions. Working closely with the Project Finance and M&A team, this role provides analytical, strategic, and execution support throughout the transaction lifecycle — from origination and due diligence to closing and portfolio management.


Responsibilities:


  • Business Acumen and Financial Literacy - Demonstrates an understanding of relevant financial metrics and concepts.
  • Resource Planning - Plans for various possible timelines and contingencies for completing assigned work.
  • Collaborative - Displays positive demeanor in interactions with others both on the team and cross-functionally.
  • Project Structuring & Execution – Understands the legal, technical, and financial components of project finance structures; effectively contributes to transaction execution from term sheet to financial close.
  • Communication & Influence – Clearly articulates financial insights and recommendations; influences decision-making through well-reasoned analysis.
  • Results Orientation – Drives deliverables to completion with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and value creation.
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility – Quickly assimilates new information, adjusts to changing deal dynamics, and continuously seeks to enhance technical and market knowledge.
  • Leadership & Mentoring – Provides guidance to junior members, reviews work outputs, and helps raise the overall quality of the team’s deliverables.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in project finance, M&A, or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in financial modeling tools (Excel, VBA).
  • Experience in cross-border transactions within LATAM markets.
  • Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of complex workstreams.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of explaining technical results to financial stakeholders.

title: System Engineer - Infrastructure and Storage
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

- Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.

• Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server

• Upgrading ESXi

• Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring

• Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs

- Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions

- Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable

- Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis

- Basic Linux administration

- On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

- Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)

- Server Hardware Management

- Virtualization, especially VMware

- Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP

- Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments

- Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Managing backups

- Dell Server Hardware

- PowerShell

- Python

- Storage Platforms such as EMC, Netapp, Isilon, etc.

- Storage Protocols, including iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS

- Storage Virtualization

- Storage Security, including access controls and encryption data at rest

- Ansible

  • Work with innovative and creative people

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)

  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction

  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team working on a large-scale, enterprise-grade, multi-tenant web platform.

In this role, you will build and maintain a sophisticated web application using modern technologies, contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, scalability, code quality, and exceptional user experience .



Technical Stack - Core Technologies


  • Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14 (Pages Router), TypeScript
  • Styling: Linaria (CSS-in-JS)
  • State Management: React Context API
  • Backend/API: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
  • Headless CMS: Contentstack
  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress (E2E)
  • Build Tools: Webpack 5, Babel, Yarn 4 (Workspaces)

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, Route53, ALB)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring: Elastic APM
  • Caching: Redis
  • Analytics: mParticle, Adobe Target


Key Responsibilities - Development


  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Build and maintain reusable, well-typed component libraries with comprehensive test coverage
  • Integrate and manage content delivery workflows using a headless CMS


Code Quality & Best Practices


  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established standards (strict TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint)
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive, high-quality feedback
  • Follow accessibility standards and best practices in semantic HTML


Collaboration


  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineering teams
  • Mentor junior engineers and lead technical knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical design discussions
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to architectural decision records


Required Qualifications - Experience


  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • 2+ years working with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks
  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS solutions (Linaria, Styled Components, or similar)
  • Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms


Technical Skills


  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript with strict typing
  • Strong understanding of React hooks, Context API, and component lifecycle
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Webpack and Babel
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Proficiency with Git and command-line workflows
  • Strong testing mindset with experience in Jest, React Testing Library, and E2E testing


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges

title: Founder Associate (Growth)
description:
Location: Brazil (remote-first, with collaboration across Europe & Latin America)

Languages: English (fluent), Portuguese (fluent), Spanish (plus)


About OpenHealth

OpenHealth is building the infrastructure layer for health data , harmonizing and enriching laboratory results to power clinics, labs, insurers, and health-tech companies across Europe and Latin America. Our mission is to unlock the full value of medical data to enable better clinical decisions, preventive care, and AI-driven health innovation.

In 2025 OpenHealth raised it’s second institutional investment round, invested by selected leading Venture Capital firms from Europe:


What You Will Do

As Founder Associate , you will work directly with our CEO and act as a force multiplier across strategy, growth, project execution, operations, and fundraising . You will take full ownership of strategic initiatives , from definition to execution, and ensure that the most important projects move fast and deliver impact.

On a typical day, you may:

  • Lead high-impact strategic projects end-to-end with full ownership, such as new market entries, launch of new products, or strategic partnerships
  • Own project management for cross-functional initiatives, including scoping, timelines, stakeholder alignment, execution tracking, and delivery
  • Drive cross-functional programs across product, tech, growth, operations, and external partners
  • Support enterprise clients and strategic partners , including preparation of proposals, business cases, and pilots
  • Prepare board- and investor-ready presentations, decision memos, KPIs, and performance reports
  • Conduct market, competitor, customer, and investor research to support strategic decisions and positioning
  • Improve and scale internal processes and workflows , leveraging automation and AI where possible
  • Support fundraising and investor relations , including pitch materials, data rooms, investor outreach, and follow-ups
  • Act as a sparring partner to the CEO , helping prioritize initiatives, challenge assumptions, and execute across multiple workstreams simultaneously


Who You Are

You are a high-ownership, execution-focused strategic generalist who enjoys operating close to decision-making and turning strategy into results.

Your profile likely includes:

  • A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Medicine , or a similarly analytical field
  • 1–3 years of high-impact professional experience , e.g. in management consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, Big Tech, health-tech, or an early-stage venture-backed startup
  • Demonstrated experience in project management , owning complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders from planning to execution
  • A clear track record of leading strategic projects under full ownership , such as new market entries, international expansion, or go-to-market initiatives
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking , with the ability to turn complex problems into clear, actionable plans
  • Proven ability to work directly with C-level executives , driving initiatives with measurable impact
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability – you proactively identify problems and deliver solutions
  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-pressure environments with shifting priorities
  • Known for being reliable, persistent, and outcome-driven , with a strong bias toward execution


What Matters to Us

  • Strong motivation for the health industry , ideally with first exposure to healthcare, health-tech, life sciences, or medical data
  • Interest in how technology, data, and AI can meaningfully improve healthcare systems and patient outcomes
  • Ability to communicate effectively across business, technical, and medical stakeholders
  • A mindset of ownership, learning, and long-term impact


Languages & Location

  • English: Fluent
  • Portuguese: Fluent
  • Spanish: Plus / nice to have
  • Location: Brazil - São Paulo or Florianopolis (working closely with teams and partners in Europe & Latin America)


Why Join OpenHealth?

  • Work directly with the founders on company-defining initiatives
  • Take full ownership of strategic projects with visible impact
  • Exposure to international markets, enterprise clients, and investors
  • Steep learning curve across health-tech, data, AI, and B2B SaaS
  • Clear growth path into senior strategy, operations, or leadership roles

title: Power BI Analyst (Projeto Temporário)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto de uma multinacional global de grande porte , referência nos segmentos de bens de consumo duráveis e tecnologia .

A posição faz parte de um projeto temporário e estratégico , conduzido pelo CIO Office , com foco na criação de uma visão unificada, automatizada e confiável de performance de TI. O objetivo é apoiar decisões executivas em nível global e fortalecer a atuação de TI como uma área orientada a resultados e geração de valor para o negócio.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter um modelo semântico centralizado no Power BI , com navegação do nível executivo até regional
  • Implementar boas práticas de modelagem de dados, DAX e otimização de performance

title: Business Performance Analyst
description:
We are hiring!


Please find the job description below. If you're interested, I would appreciate it if you could share your updated resume with me.


Role: Principal Business Performance Analyst

Location: LATAM - Remote

Type: Contract

Job Description:

We are seeking a Principal Business Performance Analyst to drive personalization and affiliate marketing analytics within our Marketing Technology team. This role focuses on turning complex data into actionable insights that improve user experience, conversions, and recurring revenue.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze the impact of personalization initiatives on key user and business metrics
  • Deliver actionable insights from affiliate performance data to drive conversion and revenue growth
  • Lead A/B and multivariate testing to optimize affiliate offers, landing pages, and user journeys
  • Develop customer segmentation and attribution models to evaluate campaign effectiveness
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau, Data Studio, or similar tools
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Tech teams to improve funnel performance and affiliate strategy


Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced analytics using Python or R
  • Experience with A/B testing, personalization, and experimentation
  • Hands-on experience with affiliate marketing analytics
  • Expertise with data platforms such as BigQuery, AWS Athena, or AWS Glue
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders

title: SDR Viagens Internacional - Sênior
description:
SDR Viagens Internacional - Sênior — LUA DE MEL & EXPERIÊNCIAS PERSONALIZADAS (BRASIL)


A Honeymooners é uma agência internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens de alto valor , com forte presença no mercado dos Estados Unidos.


Esta não é uma vaga de call center nem de agendamento mecânico.

Buscamos um(a) SDR SÊNIOR , com experiência real em vendas consultivas, capaz de criar conexão humana imediata e abrir o caminho certo para uma venda premium.


Estamos fortalecendo o topo do funil internacional e procuramos alguém que entenda que velocidade, qualidade do primeiro contato e leitura de intenção fazem toda a diferença .


O que você vai fazer:

• Ser o primeiro contato humano com casais internacionais que solicitam informações sobre a lua de mel;

• Entrar em contato rapidamente após o pedido (tempo de resposta é crítico);

• Criar uma conexão inicial de confiança e entusiasmo;

• Qualificar momento, intenção e expectativas do casal;

• Agendar reuniões qualificadas com os(as) consultores(as) de viagens;

• Garantir follow-ups consistentes e bem estruturados;

• Registrar contexto, histórico e interações no CRM.

Você não fará orçamentos nem fechará vendas.

Seu foco é conexão, clareza e agendamento de alta qualidade .


Procuramos alguém que:

• Tenha experiência comprovada como SDR ou em vendas consultivas;

• Domine CRM no dia a dia (experiência com HubSpot é um diferencial );

• Comunique-se em inglês avançado (oral e escrito);

• Tenha ritmo, disciplina e foco em métricas;

• Seja confortável em conversas por telefone e videochamada;

• Prefira ganhar por performance e impacto, não por conforto;

• Tenha maturidade para atuar em um ambiente internacional exigente.

Experiência no setor de turismo é um diferencial muito importante , especialmente com produtos de alto valor.


Esta vaga NÃO é para você se:

• Procura apenas responder mensagens ou e-mails;

• Não gosta de falar ao telefone;

• Precisa de tarefas previsíveis e ritmo lento;

• Fica desconfortável com metas claras e avaliação semanal;

• Procura algo temporário ou “tranquilo”.


Modelo de trabalho:

• Full-time;

• 100% remoto;

• Horário alinhado com o fuso dos EUA;

• Modelo de contratação: PJ.


Remuneração:

• Remuneração fixa competitiva para o mercado brasileiro;

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Analista de BI Senior - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Detalhes da oportunidade

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: CLT + Benefícios


Principais Responsabilidades

- Traduzir necessidades de negócio em indicadores, análises e visualizações claras

- Construir, manter e evoluir dashboards executivos e operacionais

- Realizar análises exploratórias e diagnósticas, identificando padrões, tendências e oportunidades

- Apoiar decisões estratégicas por meio de insights orientados por dados

- Atuar na modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física)

- Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade

- Trabalhar com dados estruturados e semiestruturados

- Garantir consistência entre fontes, métricas e camadas analíticas

- Documentar métricas, indicadores e fontes (data dictionary / métricas oficiais)

- Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados e boas práticas analíticas

- Atuar na resolução de inconsistências e problemas de dados

- Apresentar análises de forma clara, didática e orientada à ação


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

- Experiência sólida como Analista de BI / Dados

- Domínio de SQL (consultas complexas, CTEs, otimização)

- Experiência com modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, etc.)

- Vivência com ferramentas de BI

- Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados (pandas, numpy, etc.)

- Conhecimento em ETL / ELT e pipelines de dados

- Experiência com bases de dados relacionais e analíticas

- Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud (AWS)


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: M&A Advisor
description:
Expanda sua Prática de M&A: Una-se à Rede Internacional da ONEtoONE Corporate Finance


Conecte sua expertise ao mercado global. Transforme sua assessoria local em uma potência internacional.


A ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida assessores de M&A e boutiques independentes de renome no Brasil a integrarem nossa rede global. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta, colaboração internacional e um back office completo para potencializar sua originação e execução de deals no middle-market.


Quem Somos


Somos uma rede internacional de investment banking especializada em assessoria de M&A para o middle-market. Conectamos mais de 150 assessores em mais de 80 cidades ao redor do mundo, com foco em transações cross-border.


Nota Importante: Esta é uma oportunidade de Membership (Afiliação) para profissionais e firmas independentes; não se trata de uma vaga de emprego (CLT) ou prestação de serviços terceirizados.


Ferramentas e Suporte de Classe Mundial


Ao longo de duas décadas, a ONEtoONE investiu no desenvolvimento de ferramentas exclusivas que permitem aos nossos membros:


  • Originação de Elite: Conquiste mais e melhores mandatos.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Identifique compradores ou targets ideais globalmente.
  • Back Office Dedicado: Suporte em todas as fases — desde o pitch e análise financeira até a documentação e busca de contrapartes.
  • Dados Premium: Acesso a perfis de mais de 450 milhões de empresas e dados de transações globais.


Colaboração Sem Fronteiras


No Brasil, o relacionamento é a base de tudo. Nossa rede permite que você colabore com especialistas em diversos setores e países sem restrições geográficas ou setoriais. Você terá a liberdade de operar globalmente, utilizando ferramentas de IA e bancos de dados proprietários para multiplicar seu alcance e sua receita.


Perfil Ideal


Buscamos profissionais brasileiros com o seguinte perfil:


  • Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em Corporate Finance, Private Equity, M&A ou assessoria transacional.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para colaboração internacional).
  • Mindset: Perfil empreendedor, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Expertise: Forte rede de relacionamentos local e capacidade analítica.
  • Visão: Desejo de portar uma marca global de investment banking e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


O Que Você Ganha


  • Suporte Full Back Office: Originadores, analistas e especialistas em marketing, jurídico e TI à sua disposição.
  • Tecnologia de Ponta: Acesso às melhores bases de dados de M&A do mundo e ferramentas de IA exclusivas.
  • Networking Global: Conexão direta com pares em 80+ cidades e especialistas setoriais.
  • Transparência: Estrutura de fee-sharing clara que valoriza o trabalho em equipe.
  • Liberdade: Autonomia total para gerir seu negócio com o suporte de uma marca global.


Pronto para elevar o nível da sua assessoria?


Se você tem a experiência e a motivação para expandir sua prática de M&A para além das fronteiras brasileiras, convidamos você a se candidatar para a rede ONEtoONE International .

title: Sourcer Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM e Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;

title: Especialista em Eficiência Energética I
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar diagnósticos energéticos nas unidades operacionais, identificando oportunidades de otimização do consumo e melhoria de performance.
  • Desenvolver e implantar projetos de eficiência energética, incluindo análises técnicas e financeiras (payback, VPL, TIR).
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de consumo e desempenho energético, assegurando acompanhamento sistemático dos resultados.
  • Propor e implementar soluções de automação, controle e melhoria de processos, especialmente em sistemas de bombeamento, motores e acionamentos.
  • Elaborar estudos de viabilidade para fontes alternativas de energia (solar, biogás, PCH), apoiando decisões técnicas e econômicas.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as áreas de operação e manutenção, além de conduzir treinamentos, certificações e iniciativas de melhoria contínua em eficiência energética.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica, de Produção, Controle e Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Eficiência Energética, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais, saneamento ou operações com sistemas de bombeamento e motores.
  • Conhecimento técnico em sistemas de bombeamento, motores elétricos e dispositivos de acionamento, como soft-starters e inversores de frequência.
  • Noções de diagnóstico energético e hidroenergético (levantamento de dados, medições, baseline e verificação de resultados).
  • Domínio de Excel para organização e análise de dados e PowerPoint para apresentações; Power BI como diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens às unidades de negócio, conforme a necessidade dos projetos/operações.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Analista de Dados Pleno | Engenharia e Modelagem de Dados
description:
A Fasters está procurando gente talentosa para formar um time que irá atuar na área de desenvolvimento. Irá fazer parte de um ambiente voltado para inovação e irá participar ativamente no crescimento do projeto.


Buscamos um profissional com boa comunicação, que tenha facilidade de se relacionar com pessoas e que esteja constantemente se atualizando em busca de novos conhecimentos da área.


Essa vaga se destina para todo o Brasil :)


Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de ETL em larga escala, otimizados para eficiência e confiabilidade.

• Implementar processos de qualidade e validação de dados.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de BI e Data Science para suportar projetos analíticos.

• Garantir o desempenho, a escalabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas de dados.


Soft Skills:

• Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico para resolver problemas complexos.

• Comunicação efetiva e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

• Proatividade e atenção meticulosa aos detalhes.

• Adaptabilidade e resiliência.

• Gestão de tempo e priorização.


Hard Skills:

• Experiência com modernização de BI (conhecimento sobre migração de ETL e Data Warehousing).

• Modelagem de dados para analytics (criação de Data Lakes, Data Warehouses e Data Marts).

• Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e dimensionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Vertica).

• Apache Airflow.

• Conhecimento em streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

• Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL e otimização de consultas.

• Domínio do Python e suas bibliotecas.

• Conhecimento em Spark e PySpark.

• Governança de Dados (aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, como LGPD, GDPR, Privacy by Design).


Diferenciais

• Experiência com machine learning e modelos preditivos para análise de dados.

• Conhecimentos em Delta Lake.

• Experiência com API para dados em tempo real.

• Conhecimentos de cloud (AWS, Azure)


Regime de contratação PJ, 40h semanais.


Informações adicionais:

  • Acesso a plataformas de cursos.
  • Descanso remunerado;

 SharePro — Tecnologia para Inovação

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações utilizando tecnologias .NET, seguindo padrões e boas práticas
  • Desenvolver e consumir APIs REST
  • Atuar em correções, melhorias e manutenção de sistemas existentes
  • Executar testes e apoiar a identificação e correção de falhas

  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros desenvolvedores e áreas envolvidas

  • Experiência prévia como Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno  ou equivalente
  • Conhecimento sólido em .NET / .NET Core
  • Experiência com APIs REST
  • Conhecimento intermediário em SQL Server  (modelagem e consultas)
  • Experiência com MVC
  • Versionamento de código com Git
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis
  • Capacidade de seguir arquiteturas e padrões definidos


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência ou contato com Azure
  • Noções de CI/CD
  • Contato com DevOps  e automação
  • Experiência inicial com Docker / containers
  • Conhecimento em Blazor


Perfil comportamental

  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de explicar soluções técnicas
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas de média complexidade de forma independente
  • Organização, responsabilidade e comprometimento com prazos
  • Boa gestão do próprio tempo e das atividades sob sua responsabilidade
  • Postura colaborativa, abertura a feedbacks e aprendizado contínuo
  • Perfil com boa performance operacional , entregando demandas com consistência, qualidade e produtividade adequada ao nível pleno
  • Interesse genuíno em evolução técnica e crescimento profissional

title: Analista / Especialista em GIS & Documentação Técnica
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida base em Sistemas de Informação Geográfica (GIS), com perfil comunicativo e organizado, capaz de atuar na documentação técnica, apoio a usuários e disseminação de boas práticas em soluções GIS, especialmente em redes de utilities.



Principais competências e conhecimentos esperados:


  • Conhecimento em GIS, com entendimento de dados espaciais, mapas, camadas, simbologia e fluxos de trabalho.
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com redes de utilities (água, esgoto, energia, telecom ou gás), incluindo conceitos de ativos, conectividade e operação.
  • Boa escrita técnica, com capacidade de elaborar documentação clara, objetiva e orientada ao usuário.
  • Experiência com Git (controle de versões), incluindo versionamento de documentação, organização de repositórios e colaboração em equipe.
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica e funcional, como manuais, guias rápidos, FAQs, wikis e notas de versão.


Produção de materiais instrucionais, incluindo:


  • Tutoriais passo a passo
  • Vídeos explicativos
  • Figuras, diagramas e fluxos de uso para apoio ao usuário
  • Boa comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal, com capacidade de dialogar com perfis técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com padronização e qualidade da informação.


Diferenciais desejáveis:


  • Experiência com plataformas GIS corporativas ou WebGIS.
  • Vivência em ambientes colaborativos e multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de documentação técnica e UX writing.
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de utilities ou infraestrutura.

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We are seeking highly skilled Chemistry and Mathematics professionals to develop high-quality Chain of Thought (CoT) Question & Answers for advanced scientific and mathematical problem-solving.

The ideal candidate will have strong conceptual foundations, rigorous analytical skills, and experience in structured scientific reasoning. Proficiency in LaTeX is essential for producing clear, well-formatted, step-by-step solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop detailed Chain of Thought (CoT) Q&As across advanced scientific and mathematical domains.
  • Ensure logical coherence and structured reasoning in both questions and solutions.

Chemistry

  • Organic Chemistry

title: SAP Signavio Consultant
description:
SAP Signavio Consultant – Remote

Location : LATAM

Type : Contract


Job Description

We are seeking a SAP Signavio Consultant to join our team supporting process discovery, modeling, and process intelligence using SAP Signavio tools. This position is remote from Latin America and requires working in collaboration with US‑based functional and business teams (US time zones).


Responsibilities

  • Lead process discovery and modeling using SAP Signavio across core ERP domains (O2C, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support life sciences‑specific process mapping.
  • Deploy and manage SAP Signavio solutions (Process Manager, Collaboration Hub, Process Intelligence).
  • Analyze process mining data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate effectively with US teams and business stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • 4–8 years’ experience in business process management, including 2–3 years with SAP Signavio.
  • Strong understanding of life sciences operational and compliance processes.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA or ECC ERP processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills and experience working with US teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed nearshore setup.


Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Signavio certifications.
  • Experience in pharma, biotech, or medical devices.
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate or other business transformation methodologies.


Background Checks

Full background check, employment history, education verification for the last 7 years, and a mandatory 10‑panel drug test for selected candidates.


Interested? Apply here or reach out directly to start a conversation at

title: Project Manager with logistics experience - Remote

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
The HR operations manager owns the execution and continuous improvement of HR operations across the full team member lifecycle — from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role that blends operational leadership, systems ownership, and process discipline.

You will work closely with the Director of Global HR , HR Specialists, and cross-functional partners to ensure HR systems, workflows, and documentation operate smoothly and consistently across countries.

This role is centered on building, operating, and continuously elevating a high-performing HR engine, with a strong commitment to operational excellence and ongoing improvement every day.


Must haves

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience , with a strong focus on HR operations
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Location: Ukraine, Poland, Romania
  • Experience working in technology, IT, consulting, or service-based environments
  • Proven success building, running, and improving HR processes that scale with company growth
  • Hands-on experience managing HR operations for a multi-country workforce
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob preferred) and modern productivity tools
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace , and related collaboration tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions in a fast-paced, distributed environment


Nice to have

  • Experience supporting distributed, multi-country teams
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO, or similar compliance environments
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve HR workflows, reporting, or efficiency
  • Prior people management or team-lead experience
  • Experience working alongside people / ER or HRBP roles
  • Exposure to B2B, outsourcing, or billable team models


Key responsibilities

HR operations & lifecycle management

HR systems & tools ownership

  • Own and administer HRIS systems (HiBob or comparable platforms) as the system of record
  • Configure workflows, task lists, permissions, and reporting in HR systems
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date team member data
  • Partner with internal teams to integrate HR tools with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and other productivity systems

Compliance & operational risk

  • Ensure compliance with local labor regulations, internal policies, and HR controls across geographies
  • Own HR-related audit readiness and evidence gathering (including SOC2-related controls where applicable)
  • Maintain HR documentation, SOPs, and policy acknowledgements
  • Adapt policies and practices to meet regional needs while maintaining consistency

Manager enablement (process-focused)

  • Provide managers with clear guidance on HR processes, timelines, and required documentation
  • Act as the primary owner of HR operational questions and requests
  • Escalate judgment-based or sensitive employee relations matters to the director of global HR

HR team support & execution

  • Support, mentor and coordinate the work of HR Specialist or other team members as it relates to HR operational tasks
  • Prioritize operational work, ensure follow-through, and reduce single points of failure
  • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency using existing tools and AI-enabled workflows


What this role is not

  • This role does not own employee relations judgment, PIPs, or conflict mediation
  • This role does not serve as a people partner or HR business partner
  • Strategic people decisions and leadership coaching sit with the Director of Global HR

title: Senior Software Engineer – Platform
description:
Role: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability Operations

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Type: Contract


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and improve system design to reduce failure modes and promote self-healing systems
  • Establish and maintain robust systems that facilitate observability, encompassing logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, alerting, and offline test tools.
  • Work with development partners to shape the architecture, design, and implementations of new and existing systems to enhance their reliability, performance, efficiency, and scalability
  • Ability to work both independently as well as part of a geographically dispersed yet integrated team.
  • Collaborate with service engineers to establish Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for backend services.
  • Being able to identify the indications or cues that demonstrate the effectiveness of an application and having the knowledge to improve or repair its performance
  • Ability to assess options and suggest solutions when there is limited or unclear information. This position requires a level of comfort and assurance in dealing with uncertain situations.
  • Ability to work seamlessly within a team as well as manage individual tasks
  • Respond to emerging incidents, solve critical issues, and follow through with a plan for resolution or future mitigation
  • Act as an SME on the Engineering Operations team, partnering with backend services teams and application teams to overcome challenges across all the platforms where we stream our service

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years’ experience in software development
  • Degree in Computer Science or related or equivalent work experience
  • You have solid engineering and coding skills, data structure knowledge, and the ability to write high-performance production-quality code.
  • Experience building service-oriented APIs and cloud services
  • Experience designing, implementing, and deploying microservices
  • Extremely technical hands-on server software experience
  • Proficient in Golang, and JavaScript, and quick to learn new languages.
  • Experience in the Linux environment and a good understanding of its fundamentals and internals: filesystems and modern memory management, threads, and processes, the user/kernel-space divide, etc.
  • A good understanding of large-scale distributed systems in practice, including multi-tier architectures, application security, monitoring, and storage systems.
  • Working knowledge of the TCP/IP stack, internet routing, and load balancing.
  • Grit, drive, and a deep feeling of ownership.

Bonus Points for Experience with the following:

  • Golang
  • Typescript
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • Open telemetry
  • eBPF
  • Datadog
  • Helm Charts
  • HLS video transcoding, distribution & playback
  • Experience designing, implementing, and running services in high demand high-traffic environments
  • Experience with high-availability services

title: Pessoa Analista de DP Sênior
description:
Sobre a empresa


A Oficina é parceira estratégica na criação de reputação e relacionamento, por meio de histórias e causas que transformam o país.


Em 2025 lançamos um novo modelo de negócios que integra a agilidade de uma agência, a profundidade estratégica de uma consultoria e a força de uma atuação em rede.

Nesse contexto, nasceu a Rede de Reputação e Influência , a primeira Community as a Service (CaaS) de Reputação e Influência do Brasil. A iniciativa reúne 40 empresas parceiras com atuação regional e nacional, combinando tecnologia, inteligência e colaboração para antecipar cenários e apoiar decisões com agilidade e precisão.


Nos pautamos em valores como respeito, diversidade, inquietude, ética, excelência no atendimento e trabalho em equipe. title: Analista de Dados - Google Analytics & GCP
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Analista de Dados - Google Analytics & GCP , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.


Buscamos um (a) Analista de Dados que seja a principal referência técnica da empresa no uso estratégico e tático do ecossistema Google para dados. O papel exige proficiência total no Google Analytics 4 (GA4) para extrair insights profundos do comportamento do usuário e uma base sólida no Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularmente o BigQuery, para manipular e analisar grandes volumes de dados. Este profissional será fundamental para a tomada de decisões baseada em dados em toda a organização.

Principais atividades:

- Liderar em Google Analytics (GA4):

- Gerenciar e otimizar totalmente a implementação e configuração do GA4, garantindo a mais alta qualidade e integridade dos dados de comportamento do usuário.

- Definir e manter o plano de mensuração completo (eventos, parâmetros, dimensões personalizadas) via Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Liderar a análise de funis de conversão, performance de canais e modelos de atribuição, gerando recomendações diretas para Marketing e Produto.

- Governança de Dados via GCP/BigQuery:

- Ser o (a) ponto focal na utilização do Google BigQuery para ingestão, processamento e modelagem de dados web e transacionais em larga escala.

- Escrever e otimizar consultas SQL avançadas, realizando operações de ETL/ELT para combinar dados de GA4 (via exportação direta), CRM e outras fontes.

- Monitorar e gerenciar recursos do GCP (Cloud Storage, BigQuery) para garantir eficiência e controle de custos.

Visualização e Comunicação:

- Desenvolver dashboards complexos e automatizados no Looker Studio (Data Studio), garantindo que os insights sejam claros, acionáveis e acessíveis aos líderes e equipes operacionais.

- Apresentar resultados analíticos de forma persuasiva, traduzindo métricas técnicas em impacto financeiro e estratégico.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Os candidatos devem demonstrar proficiência e experiência comprovada nos seguintes pontos:

- Google Analytics (GA4): Avançado/Especialista em configuração, migração, auditoria e uso estratégico da plataforma (Relatórios Padrão e Análises Exploratórias).

- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Familiaridade sólida com a plataforma GCP, incluindo Cloud Storage e IAM.

- BigQuery e SQL: Avançada para escrever, otimizar e gerenciar consultas SQL complexas em ambientes de Big Data (BigQuery).

- Visualização de Dados: Proficiência em Looker Studio (Data Studio) para construção de relatórios e painéis automatizados e performáticos.

- Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 3 a 5 anos como Analista de Dados, com foco direto em Web Analytics e Big Data.


Requisitos diferenciais:

- Conhecimentos e experiência com a linguagem de modelagem Looker ML.

- Certificações oficiais Google.

- Familiaridade com Python para análise e manipulação de dados.


Interessados podem se candidatar pelo Linkedin ou enviar CV para

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles
